  u=2364, a=1306,

  0, -1, -omega^(2s), -omega^(4s),

  (omega^(2*i*s)-omega^(t+2*j*s)) / (omega^t-1).

  Lambda = {-gamma*omega^(t-1+2*(i-1)*s): 1<=t<=s, 1<=i<=3}.

alpha=-gamma*omega^(t-1+2*(i-1)*s), then A_alpha contains the three points
  (omega^(t-1+2*j*s), layer i-1), j=0,1,2.
